text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + 429 rates observed on /v1/generate API across us-east-1 gateway (p95 latency spiking). Auto-escalation -> paging oncall-sre.

maria.g: saw the alert, looking at Grafana now — 5xx up ~18% in last 3m, 429s also spiking. Recent config deploy at 03:02 UTC changed global quota policy? :thinking_face:

kevin.w: confirming, I pushed rate-limiter config (rollout id rl-2026-04-12) about 03:00 UTC. It switched some tenants to fallthrough global quota.

samir: logs show a bunch of gateway timeouts from downstream model workers once bursts hit the global token bucket exhaustion. 429s from the gateway -> retries -> overload -> 5xx from model pool. Cascade pattern.

arjun: copying important metrics: gateway_429_count increased from 120/min to 4200/min; model_pool_5xx increased from 2% -> 24%.

maria.g: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert rl-2026-04-12 2) open temporary emergency quota to allow burst for pinned tenants 3) throttle aggressive retrying clients via edge rule.

kevin.w: starting rollback now: `kubectl -n infra set image deployment/rate-limiter rate-limiter=registry/redwood/rl:2026-04-11`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for deployment/rate-limiter (user kevin.w) — watch: https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/rl-rollback-3087654321

samir: while rollback streams, I'm applying a emergency patch to the gateway to reject large retry storms: `edge-config set retry_limit=2` and adding 503->429 mapping to preserve backpressure.

product-ops: customer-impact check: which customers affected? any high-tier SLAs at risk?

maria.g: quick sample shows 12 active tenants with increased error rates, two enterprise customers (acme-inc, finapp) report degraded generation throughput. CS pinged them.

oncall-sre: Rollback finished — rate-limiter pods back to previous image. Observability: 429 rate dropped ~60% within 90s, 5xx still elevated but trending down.

kevin.w: root cause confirmation: the new config bound a global quota that shared tokens across backends; a mis-ordered rule allowed client-level fallthrough to that global bucket. When a burst hit, per-client buckets drained and retries funneled into the same stream.

samir: temporary measure executed: bumped global burst cap from 2000 -> 10000 via runtime flag, and disabled automatic retry-smoothing for 10 minutes. Command: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://admin/gateway/runtime -d '{"global_burst":10000}'`

maria.g: monitoring. p95 latency down from 1200ms -> 520ms over 3m. Still seeing tail 5xx from a subset of model replicas; scaling them up now: `kubectl scale --replicas=15 deploy/model-pool`

product-ops: draft customer message: "We briefly experienced elevated errors on generation endpoints affecting some customers. Mitigation in progress; engineers rolled back a rate-limit change and applied temporary capacity increases. We'll follow up with RCA." Approve?

arjun: fine to send now, add note that no data exfiltration and we prioritized enterprise workloads.

kevin.w: applying long-term fix ticket: RL-4567 to add per-tenant hard caps and unit tests to prevent fallthrough to global bucket. Assigning to me.

oncall-sre: handing off to day oncall: summary -> rollback performed, global burst increased, model-pool scaled, retry smoothing disabled, edge retry limit enforced. Action items for day: verify no residual rate-leak, run synthetic churn test, validate quota metrics in staging.

maria.g: last checks: customer error pages cleared, dashboards stable. We'll keep this thread updated if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

product-ops: sent customer note to acme-inc and finapp, CS on standby.

samir: logs snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-04-12T03:05:41Z gateway | INFO | request_id=abc123 | status=429 | tenant=acme-inc | reason=global_quota_exhausted
2026-04-12T03:05:42Z model-pool | ERROR | request_id=abc124 | status=502 | worker=replica-7 | reason=timeout
```

kevin.w: opening postmortem doc RL-4567, will include timeline, config diff, rollback steps and remediation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: Sev2 (customer impact, partial). Pager cleared.

oncall-sre: handing to day shift (arjun) for follow-ups. Key follow-ups: validate fix in canary, add automated alert to detect global-bucket fallthrough, and add playbook steps for immediate emergency-burst unblock.

arjun: acknowledged, will run the canary and schedule a 11:00am sync with infra and runtime teams.

maria.g: thanks all — great fast coordination. :thumbsup:

product-ops: adding note to incident timeline: affected endpoints /v1/generate, /v1/chat.generate; start 03:00 UTC, mitigation 03:07 UTC, rollback 03:09 UTC, stable 03:11 UTC.

samir: leaving a final diagnostic: cascading pattern was 429 -> client retry -> amplified load -> model timeouts -> 5xx fanout. Primary fix is config-safety and per-tenant isolation.

oncall-sre: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see regression.
